document.title: Minimal JSON Document Format for LLMs
document.purpose: Explain the document format simply so an LLM can write documents that conform to it.
author: Lion Kimbro
Wing-Cat (Chat-GPT)

format: A document is a JSON object.
It must have a top-level key named "document".
The value of "document" is the document header.
All other top-level keys are the body of the document.
conventions: Usually put project first and version last in document-id.
guidance-for-llms: Always write a top-level "document" key header containing the document header.
Always include document-id, title, tags, and purpose.
Then add whatever body sections make sense.
Use the header for identity and orientation.
Use the rest of the document for content.
